AN  ACT TO AMEND THE WELFARE SOCIETY OF THE SCHOOL FOR THE
MENTALLY SUBNORMAL CHILD (INCORPORATION) ACT, NO. 75 OF 1988
WHEREAS  the  Welfare  Society  of  the  School  for  the
Mentally subnormal Child was incorporated by the Welfare
Society  of  the  School  for  the  Mentally  subnormal  Child
Act, No. 75 of 1988:
AND WHEREAS the Welfare Society of the School for the
Mentally subnormal Child now wish to change its name to
“Chitra  Lane  Welfare  Society  for  Children  with  Special
Needs”:
AND WHEREAS the said Welfare Society of the School for
the Mentally subnormal Child, has now applied to have the
said Act, amended to give effect to such change in its name
and it will be expedient to grant such application:
BE it therefore enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic
Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

1.
This Act may be cited as the Welfare Society of the
School  for  the  Mentally  Subnormal  Child  (Incorporation)
(Amendment) Act, No. 45 of  2014.
